description:
MORS face recognition datasets
	

Preprocessed benchmark trees used in Face Recognition via Synthetic Data and Turbocharged Two-Stage Contrastive Fine-Tuning (MORS 2026).
Code & supplementary figures: GitHub — FR-via-SynData-and-TC-2SCFT
Each folder is a complete mirror of the local benchmark tree used in our experiments: training images (originals + synthetics), official test/eval splits, protocol .mat files, and feature caches where present. Nothing is stripped for upload.… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/afro-chai/FR-via-SynData-and-TC-2SCFT.
